Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #SLPRSD

Issued at 04:05 AM 01 October 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #OrientalMindoro(PuertoGalera, SanTeodoro), #Romblon(Cajidiocan, SanFernando, Magdiwang, Odiongan, SantaMaria, Alcantara, Looc, SantaFe, Ferrol and SanJose) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #OrientalMindoro(Baco, CityOfCalapan, Naujan), #Romblon(Romblon, SanAgustin, Calatrava, SanAndres, Concepcion, Banton and Corcuera) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #SLPRSD
